verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official, npm-installable `sf` CLI. Its commands can drive the platform headlessly: creating scratch orgs, querying data, running Apex tests, and creating and activating agents. DevOps Center is pitched for build/test/deploy, and a community user calls the CLI passable with an easy deployment path. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents running in CI pipelines or non-interactive authentication. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless/non-interactive auth (e.g., JWT or service-account login) evidence, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Empower teams to build, test, and deploy AI-powered apps and agents securely at scale with Agentforce DevOps Center.
With SFDC I get a passable command line tool, multiple VS Code extensions, an easy deployment path
